I needed a tiny funnel to fill these little jars. This fit exactly. It came in a multi pack, but one is all I need, it holds up so well.Worked great for me for powder, liquid and even syrup consistency. Keep in mind they are a small funnel so it will take time and a slow pour to use without clogging (slightly tapping the funnel on the bottle opening can help speed things up). I prefer this over the metal ones as they always have a funky seam that seems to collect stuff, while these plastic ones are a single piece so nothing to snag on. I was even able to clean them in my dishwasher and it survived just fine.I use these for adding powder or glitter to cosmetics. They're a great size for lotions and I love having extra on hand. They're firm plastic, reusable, washable, and small enough to tuck away to store.I used these in a workshop for a diy throat spray & they were the perfect size . Everyone loved them & wanted to keep them . Would buy again great value & quality.I used these little funnels in my class for a DNA extraction. They worked perfectly for the tiny volumes.Perfect size, dishwasher sizeNiceThese were just the right size for inserting into the inlet of a medical bag to clean it, while still allowing a reasonable flow of water or vinegar solution.Great for filling your lotions, or happy juiceI grow cacti and other succulents as a hobby, and I purchased this set of tiny funnels since they fit inside a 1 or 2 seam glass vial, which is what I use for seed storage. The seeds don’t stick at all to the sides of these funnels, so for my purpose, they’re great.
